tools.name: arxiv_search
tools.description: Search arXiv papers by query with category and sort filters. Returns paper metadata including title, authors, abstract, categories, and links.

params.name: query
params.description: Search query. Field prefixes: ti: (title), au: (author — token-based; quote multi-token names like au:"hinton g" or pair with a topical clause to disambiguate common surnames), abs: (abstract), cat: (

params.name: start
params.description: Pagination offset (0-10000). Use with max_results to page through results. E.g., start=10 with max_results=10 returns results 11-20.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Sort criterion. Use "submitted" for newest papers, "relevance" for best query matches.

params.name: category
params.description: Filter results to a specific arXiv category (e.g., "cs.CL", "math.AG"). Use arxiv_list_categories to discover valid codes.

params.name: sort_order
params.description: Sort direction. "descending" returns newest/most relevant first.

params.name: max_results
params.description: Maximum results to return (1-50). Default 10. Each result includes title, authors, abstract, and metadata — keep low to limit response size.

tools.name: arxiv_get_metadata
tools.description: Get full metadata for one or more arXiv papers by ID. Use when you have known IDs from citations, prior search results, or memory.

params.name: paper_ids
params.description: arXiv paper ID or array of up to 10 IDs. Format: "2401.12345" or "2401.12345v2" (with version). Also accepts legacy IDs like "hep-th/9901001".

tools.name: arxiv_read_paper
tools.description: Fetch the full text of an arXiv paper as HTML. Tries arxiv.org/html first; falls back to ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org when the native render is unavailable. PDF-only papers (no HTML render on either source) return an html_unavailable error with the pdf_url for direct download. Page through long papers with the start and max_characters parameters.

params.name: start
params.description: Character offset into the cleaned body to begin reading from. Defaults to 0. Use with max_characters to page through long papers — e.g., start=100000 with max_characters=100000 returns chars 100,000–1

params.name: max_characters
params.description: Maximum characters of paper body content to return. Defaults to 100,000. HTML head/boilerplate is stripped before counting. When truncated, a notice and total character count are included.

tools.name: arxiv_list_categories
tools.description: List arXiv category codes and names. Useful for discovering valid category filters for arxiv_search.

params.name: group
params.description: Filter by top-level group (e.g., "cs", "math", "physics"). Returns all categories if omitted.

resources.name: arXiv Categories
resources.description: Full arXiv category taxonomy. Returns grouped category list as JSON.
